Karnataka Minister Orders Review of Bengaluru Police Action on Protesters

Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge has ordered a review of the Bengaluru police's handling of anti-SIR (Strategic Interventions and Reforms) protesters who were detained on Monday. The review follows allegations that police forcibly removed demonstrators and manhandled journalists covering the protest. Kharge stated that peaceful protest is fundamental to democracy.
